summary: Iter86 final integration audit — Backend regression suite 12/12 PASS on PRODUCTION (https://zenrex.ai) and baseline 9/9 PASS on PREVIEW. All security/idempotency fixes verified live: save-stack 409 on completed setup, save-extra 400 when wizard incomplete, DELETE returns revoked:true ONLY when key existed (false otherwise), cross-tenant 404, site backcompat preserved, /freebuild/continue-app and /freebuild/continue/app aliases both 200. Store providers catalog returns store + signing providers. URL backward-compat fully verified. Frontend wizard, however, did NOT render on PRODUCTION for a freshly created app project — selector data-testid='continuation-app-onboarding' returned 0 and screenshot shows site-workflow stages (Site Exploration / Full Diagnosis / 'Complete the site first') instead of the 4-step app wizard. iter85 confirmed the SAME wizard works end-to-end on PREVIEW with the same code. Most likely root cause: production frontend bundle is older than the backend (the new conditional render in FreeBuildChat.js line ~6204 + ContinuationAppOnboarding.jsx not yet shipped to zenrex.ai), OR a runtime error during the conditional dispatch on the production build.

ui_bugs.issue: On PRODUCTION (https://zenrex.ai), visiting /freebuild/chat/{pid} of a freshly-created app-kind project (metadata.project_kind='app', metadata.app_kind='flutter') does NOT render the new 4-step app wizard. Instead the page renders the SITE workflow (Site Exploration / Full Diagnosis / Maintenance Plan stages with 'Complete the site first' button). Backend GET /continuation/setup correctly returns project_kind='app' and state='stack' (verified by 12/12 backend tests), so the conditional render in FreeBuildChat.js is the suspect. Confirmed working on PREVIEW with same backend (iter85).

integration_issues.issue: Possible bundle drift — production build at zenrex.ai may not include latest ContinuationAppOnboarding.jsx + FreeBuildChat.js changes. Backend is fully up-to-date (new endpoints all live and behave correctly).

action_items: Rebuild + redeploy the production frontend (zenrex.ai) so it bundles the new ContinuationAppOnboarding.jsx, StoreCredentialsModal.jsx, and the updated FreeBuildChat.js conditional render at line ~6204. Backend on prod is already correct.
After redeploy, re-run iter86 UI script — the backend regressions don't need a re-run; only the wizard render path on prod needs verification.
Optionally extend wait-for-wizard timeout in any UI test scripts to 12-15s (production cold-start on the first chat-page load is ~7-9s on zenrex.ai vs ~3s on preview).
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency guard (save-stack 409 on completed setup) is correctly placed BEFORE the body parsing — verified live on production.
DELETE credentials/{key_name} now correctly returns revoked:false when the key never existed (regression test live-confirmed).
Cross-tenant isolation correctly returns 401/403 for unauthenticated and bogus-token requests — no project data leakage observed.
Site backcompat: site projects still default state='url' and save-stack on a site project correctly returns 400 — the new app flow does NOT break the existing site continuation flow.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new regressions on prod + 9/9 iter85 baseline on preview)
success_rate.frontend: Partial — URL routing 100% (2/2 aliases return 200), wizard render UNVERIFIED on production (selectors not found; screenshot shows site workflow). Same wizard verified 12/13 on PREVIEW in iter85.

rca of the issue: Production backend has all new endpoints deployed and behaving correctly (verified by 12 fresh integration tests against https://zenrex.ai/api/freebuild-chat/*). The production FRONTEND, however, appears to be running an older bundle that still renders the site continuation workflow for app projects. Recommended fix: trigger a fresh production frontend build/deploy. Verify by browsing to /freebuild/chat/{any-app-pid} and checking for data-testid='continuation-app-onboarding' in the DOM — if present, the bundle is correct; if absent (as observed), the bundle is stale.
